tests.name: dc_regulation
tests.message: worst |vout-1.0V| over the 0-20mA DC sweep = 800mV at tt/1.8V/+27C/vmax_v (max 30mV)

finish_summary: Implemented /app/circuit.spi with a VIN-biased folded PMOS-input amplifier, PMOS pass transistor, internal 120k/80k divider, and 962 pF total ideal capacitance. Public policy checks pass. All three circuit candidates have been consumed, so no further edits were made. Final nominal development simulations expose a feedback-polarity error: output remains near VIN rather than regulating. At tt/27 C/1.65 V, DC output spans 1.63174–1.64999 V over 0–20 mA; no-load VIN current is 58.74 uA. Nominal PSR is approximately -0.13 dB, and startup peaks at 1.79926 V for 1.8 V input. Thus the final circuit does not meet the regulation, transient, startup, or PSR targets. Full PVT matrices were not run after this decisive nominal failure.
